LanguageData.RimLLM_CompatIntro: Route another mod's LLM traffic through RimLLM's fallback chain, budget, throttling and usage statistics — without that mod having to support RimLLM itself. Toggles take effect immediately; no restart needed.

LanguageData.RimLLM_CompatOfflineFallbackNote: If RimLLM has no usable provider at request time (empty fallback chain, missing keys), the request silently falls back to the mod's native path and a warning is logged.

LanguageData.RimLLM_SetupKeyHelp:
A key is like a password the AI company gives you. To get one:
1. Press the button below to open the {0} website in your browser
2. Log in and press "Create API key"
3. Press "Copy", come back and paste it in the box below (Ctrl+V)

LanguageData.RimLLM_ApiTimeoutHint: Give up if the AI takes too long. Raise it only for slow internet or local AI.
LanguageData.RimLLM_MaxRetriesHint: How many times to retry the same model before moving to the next one.
LanguageData.RimLLM_RetryDelayHint: Wait a bit before each retry so the AI company does not block you.
LanguageData.RimLLM_MaxConcurrentRequestsHint: How many questions can be sent at once. Higher is faster but uses free quota faster.
LanguageData.RimLLM_EnableNativeSchemaHint: Makes the AI answer in the exact format requested, so fewer errors. Turn off only if a local model has trouble.
LanguageData.RimLLM_EnableJsonRepairHint: Fixes small format mistakes in AI answers. Best left on.
LanguageData.RimLLM_ReasoningEffortHint: How long the AI "thinks" before answering. Longer is smarter but slower and pricier.
LanguageData.RimLLM_DailyBudgetLimitHint: Max tokens per day, 0 means no limit. Set it only if you worry about cost.
LanguageData.RimLLM_BudgetPolicyHint: What happens after the limit: block requests, or only warn you.
LanguageData.RimLLM_EnableAntiAbuseHint: Brakes automatically when a buggy mod keeps asking the AI nonstop, so your bill does not explode. Best left on.
